Team,

I'm sending a first-pass document for a targeted support pathway for Ethan Park. Over the last two quarters we've seen recurring missed delivery dates and several unaddressed code-quality defects tied to sprint ownership. I drafted a short 30-day support plan that focuses on measurable outcomes, weekly check-ins, and explicit success criteria.

Please review the attached: support_plan_v1.docx and the accompanying metrics (performance_metrics_nov.csv). Key asks:
- Legal/HR review for language around expectations and escalation (Laura / Monica)
- Manager input on specific examples and timeline (Rishi)
- Agreement on communication cadence and who gets copied when we share with the employee

Notes / constraints:
- This is confidential. Do not forward or include Ethan on any of these threads until we have final signoff from HR + Legal.
- Prefer to keep records in the secure HR Drive folder (link below) and use DocuSign for any formal acknowledgement.

Proposed timeline:
- 11/17: HR+Legal signoff on language
- 11/18: Manager finalizes examples and sends to HR
- 11/20: Manager 1:1 with Ethan to present the pathway (contingent on approvals)

I'm available to sync 11/15 afternoon or 11/16 morning if helpful.

Thanks,
--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Engineering

Karthik —

Thanks for the draft and the clear timeline. I made a few redline suggestions (attached: support_plan_v1_LB_edit.docx). High-level legal perspective:

- Remove any absolute phrasing about immediate termination; replace with "failure to meet objective criteria may result in further corrective action, up to and including termination." This keeps options open and reduces risk of imprecise language.
- Make success criteria measurable and objective (e.g., two consecutive sprints with <3 defects attributable to the individual, or 90% on-time delivery for assigned tickets).
- Add a short confidentiality blurb and limit distribution to the people directly involved.
- If we intend to document acknowledgement, use DocuSign for an acknowledgement receipt rather than an email reply; that creates a clearer audit trail.

I put legal partners on cc for quick eyes — if they have follow-ups I'll let you know. I can join a 30-minute sync on 11/17 10:00am PT to finalize wording.

Laura Bennett
VP, People & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks — I reviewed the redlines and added HR template language to ensure consistent process. Attached is our HR_template_pip.docx with the sections I tweaked. A few operational notes:

- Weekly check-ins: recommend 30-minute focused coaching sessions with clear agenda + notes stored in the HR file.
- Evidence pack: Rishi, please compile dated examples (PR links, missed deadlines, code review comments) and place them in the secure folder. We need the evidence to support each objective.
- Success criteria: we should include both quantitative (defects, timeliness) and qualitative (peer feedback, demonstrated ownership).
- Escalation flow: if after the 30-day window there is insufficient progress, we move to a 60-day moderated improvement plan; include People Ops for the escalation meeting.

Confidentiality reminder: limit distribution. Use the Drive link below for collaborative editing; I set permissions to HR+manager only.

Proposed next steps:
1) Rishi compiles evidence by EOD 11/18
2) Laura + Monica finalize language in our 11/17 sync
